$comment: Settings for the claims analysis (datalayer/claims/). Edit and rebuild; no code changes.
source_documents: which EDIS documents an analysis reads. Only public documents whose
document_type is listed under some kind are sources, so parties' filings never are. Among
those, the first kind whose title_patterns (case-insensitive regular expressions) match the
title wins (kinds are tried in the order below, so notice_of_institution comes before
commission_notice); otherwise the kind that lists the document_type.
exclude_title_patterns: documents never read, whatever their type. EDIS's 'F.R. Notice ...'
copies are the Federal Register reprints of Commission notices: duplicates, in a three-
column layout that OCR reads across.
ruling_keywords / argument_keywords: the candidate-sentence prefilter. A sentence from a
decision is sent to the model only if it names claims and has ruling language; one with
argument language and no ruling language is dropped. Matching ignores case, except for
keywords written in capitals (GRANTED, ORDERED), which must appear in capitals.
position_heading_patterns: headings whose sections describe the parties' positions;
sentences under them are dropped.
complaint_keywords: a complaint sentence that names claims is sent if it has one of these.
model / second_pass_model: model IDs. prices: US dollars per million tokens, from
https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (checked 2026-09-24).
batch_multiplier applies to Batch API requests and stacks with the cache prices.
ocr: scanned pages (no text layer) are read locally with OCR, free but about 5 seconds a
page, and cached. complaint_pages: only a complaint's first pages are OCR'd (exhibits
follow); max_pages: the most pages OCR'd in any one document.
extraction: sentences per model call, a cap on sentences per build, and output tokens.
costs_csv: where every create/update/retry run's model cost is appended, relative to the
project folder unless absolute.
budget_usd: builds stop before a model call that could take the total in costs_csv past this.
second_pass: send flagged events to second_pass_model before human review (phase 3). Off.

document_types: ID/RD - Other Than Final on Violation
